g.title: Figure title
g.text: Stage S2c -- future-query cross-attention over a retained 4x4 spatial field
Vision never joins the token sequence. The forecast positions cross-attend a coarsened V-JEPA field inside the last four encoder blocks.

g.title: Input tensors
g.text: the 12 ahead are known, not predicted
8 RGB frames over a 6 h window

g.title: Per-modality front ends
g.text: out: patched context and per-patch mask
plus (loc, scale), kept for the inverse
each covariate channel becomes its own
token row on the batch axis (mask = 1)
the patch grid is kept, not pooled away

g.title: Projection into the 512-d token space
g.text: patch in = 16 but patch out = 4, so the future patch no longer fits the context embedding
a separate future_patch_embedding is built; it has no pretrained counterpart and must learn
V-JEPA patches project straight to KV

g.title: MultimodalEmbedding, numeric sequence only
g.text: segment {context, horizon} + token-type {target, covariate} + entity id -- identical to Stage 1
modality is a dead channel here (no visual token exists). lead_time_embed[0:3] hits the 3 forecast positions.

g.title: Chronos2Encoder
g.text: top 3 of 6 unfrozen; cross-attention exists in blocks 3 to 6
causal self-attention along the TIME axis, rotary positions.
The sequence here is purely numeric: no visual token holds a
position, so this sub-layer is unchanged from Stage 1.
this is where vision enters in S2c
the 3 forecast positions QUERY the 64 visual KV entries; a gate
keeps the update on those rows, so the history stays untouched.
acts on the BATCH axis, not time. Fuses the target row with
the 14 covariate rows across a shared group_id.
No visual row exists here, unlike S2a.
-> residual add. Blocks 1 to 3 frozen; blocks 4 to 6 train.
The cross-attention is exempt: new weight, no counterpart.

g.title: Output head, forecast and loss
g.text: reads the 3 forecast positions; the field is never read
valid horizon steps only; night is masked
reported as NMAE, NRMSE, Skill Score
the 3 forecast positions, target rows only: [B, 3, 512]
